pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhaddāya kāpilāniyā antevāsī bhikkhunī bhaddaṃ kāpilāniṃ sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭheti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.4: “ayaṃ maṃ, ayye bhikkhunī sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭheti imissāhaṃ cīvaraṃ dassāmī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.5: atha kho sā bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpesi:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.6: “ahaṃ kira ayye ayyaṃ na sakkaccaṃ upaṭṭhemi, na kira me ayyā cīvaraṃ dassatī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpessatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpesīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpessati.”
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc18:1.15.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī duggahitena dūpadhāritena paraṃ ujjhāpeyya pācittiya”nti.
